sentences.englishText: A typical Japanese household consists of modern rooms with wooden floors alongside traditional rooms covered with special straw tatami mats.
sentences.turkishText: Tipik bir Japon evi, ahşap zeminli modern odaların yanı sıra özel hasır tatami hasırlarla kaplı geleneksel odalardan oluşur.

sentences.englishText: People usually sleep on a comfortable futon mattress which is carefully folded and stored inside a spacious closet during the day.
sentences.turkishText: İnsanlar genellikle gün boyunca dikkatlice katlanıp geniş bir dolabın içinde saklanan rahat bir futon yatakta uyurlar.

sentences.englishText: The traditional Japanese diet heavily features a wide variety of rice dishes, fresh seafood, noodles, and healthy soy bean products.
sentences.turkishText: Geleneksel Japon diyeti, çok çeşitli pirinç yemekleri, taze deniz ürünleri, erişteler ve sağlıklı soya fasulyesi ürünlerine yoğun bir şekilde yer verir.

sentences.englishText: The Japanese strongly believe that a meal must be aesthetically pleasing to the eyes before it is actually tasted with the mouth.
sentences.turkishText: Japonlar, bir yemeğin ağızla tadılmadan önce estetik açıdan göze hoş gelmesi gerektiğine güçlü bir şekilde inanırlar.

sentences.englishText: Traditional silk kimonos are extremely expensive garments that are mostly worn during formal occasions such as weddings, funerals, or special tea ceremonies.
sentences.turkishText: Geleneksel ipek kimonolar, çoğunlukla düğünler, cenazeler veya özel çay seremonileri gibi resmi durumlarda giyilen son derece pahalı giysilerdir.

enrichment.summary: A typical Japanese household consists of modern rooms with wooden floors alongside traditional rooms covered with special straw tatami mats. People usually sleep on a comfortable futon mattress which is carefully folded and stored inside a spacious closet during the day.
